description: State of the settlement of one order, as the billing side sees it.

awaiting-payment.description: The order exists in shop but no payment fact has arrived.

ORDER_PAID.description: First fact for this order id; the window opens here.

posting.description: The ledger is turning the payment fact into double-entry legs.

entry-pending.description: Legs computed, not yet acknowledged by the ledger store.

entry-posted.description: Both legs are durable; the batch awaits reconciliation.

settled.description: Order and ledger agree; the settlement window is closed.

disputed.description: A human owns it now — see the audit-trail requirement.
